title: exp.health/1
description: Output of `exp-<component> health --json` (01 section 8.1). Exit 0 = healthy, must answer in under 5 s, at most 64 KiB (size is enforced by the caller).

metrics.description: Open object; the agent copies it into the status report. Expected keys by component type -- probe: measurements_per_min, by_test_per_min (map test->n), fail_per_min, error_per_min, spool_depth, spool_bytes, push_lag_s, clock_offset_ms, skipped_per_hour, ports (array of {id,iface,role,link,leased,ip,gateway,rx_pps,tx_pps,rx_bps,tx_bps,rx_errors,tx_errors,rx_drops,tx_drops,last}). collector: ingest_records_per_s, ingest_rejected_per_min, ingest_duplicates_per_min, ingest_bytes_per_s, probes_total, probes_reporting, probes (array, at most 500, latest per-probe rows {probe_id,last_seen,records_per_min,clock_offset_ms}), vm_up (0/1), vm_backlog_points, vm_series, vm_storage_gb, records_db_gb, storage_free_gb, days_to_full (null when growth<=0), sse_clients, open_incidents, webhook_failures_1h, rules_eval_ms_p95. dashboard: sessions_active, requests_per_min, sse_clients, collectors_total, collectors_reachable, login_failures_1h. runner: drills_active, pullers (array of {source,last_ok,errors_1h}); M6 adds correlations_per_hour, evidence_lag_s_p95, syslog_lines_per_s, syslog_dropped_per_min. speedtest (M6): tests_per_hour, active_tests, queue_depth, internet_leg_paused (0/1), local_leg_gbps_p95, rejected_per_hour.

probes.description: Collector: per-probe latest figures (CR-wp5-fleet-api-gaps item 2); the manager keeps the latest values only.

facts.description: Expected keys by type -- probe: collector_reachable, collector_url, mode. collector: tls_fingerprint_sha256, listen. dashboard: tls_fingerprint_sha256, url. runner: inventory (bounded). speedtest: url (http:// by default, https:// when tls.mode = provided), tls_fingerprint_sha256 (only when provided), tls_mode.
